CSE 4111 / CSE 4112

Machine Learning

Perceptron, Backpropagation calculus, Momentum, RBF networks, Decision Trees (ID3/C4.5/CART), Ensembles, and Nature-Inspired Evolutionary Optimization (GA, PSO, ACO).

FACULTY: Prof. Dr. M.A.H. Akhand (Sec A) & Prof. Dr. Kazi Md. Rokibul Alam (Sec B)
ARCHIVE: 528 Pages (19 Decks) · 241 Exam Questions · 18 Topics
CSE 3201 / CSE 3202

Computer Networks

Network layer architecture, IPv4/IPv6 addressing & CIDR, Subnetting, Routing algorithms (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford, BGP/OSPF), Link layer CSMA/CD, Reliable Data Transfer, and TCP Congestion Control.

FACULTY: Prof. Dr. Md. Sakhawat Hossen (Sec A) & Md. Foisal Hossain Sadi (Sec B)
ARCHIVE: 1,003 Pages (16 Decks) · 274 Exam Questions · 21 Topics
CSE 4109 / CSE 4110

Computer & Network Security

Cryptographic primitives, Number theory, RSA, Diffie-Hellman key exchange, DES, AES, Hash functions (SHA-512), Digital signatures, Firewalls, SSL/TLS, and Malware defenses.

FACULTY: Prof. Dr. Pintu Chandra Shill & Dola Mam (Sec A) & Prof. Dr. Kazi Md. Rokibul Alam (Sec B)
ARCHIVE: 1,130 Pages (29 Decks) · 338 Exam Questions · 21 Topics
CSE 4241 / CSE 4242

Natural Language Processing

Text processing, Regular expressions, N-gram language models, Laplace smoothing, HMM Part-of-Speech tagging, Viterbi decoding, CFG parsing, TF-IDF vector semantics, and Transformer attention models.

FACULTY: Dr. Abu Shamim Mohammad Arif (Sec A) & Prof. Dr. Kazi Md. Rokibul Alam (Sec B)
ARCHIVE: 604 Pages (17 Decks) · 196 Exam Questions · 17 Topics
CSE 4107 / CSE 4108

Computer Graphics

Raster scan displays, Bresenham line & midpoint circle drawing, 2D/3D transformations, Rodrigues rotation formula, Cohen-Sutherland clipping, Bezier curves, and Z-buffer visible surface detection.

FACULTY: Prof. Dr. Masudul Sir
ARCHIVE: 472 Pages (7 Decks) · 255 Exam Questions · 16 Topics
CSE 4125 / CSE 4126

Image Processing & Computer Vision

Sampling and quantization, Histogram equalization, 2D spatial convolution, separable filters, frequency domain Fourier transforms, Otsu optimal thresholding, and morphological image processing.

FACULTY: Prof. Dr. Masudul Ahsan Sir
ARCHIVE: 475 Pages (7 Decks) · 213 Exam Questions · 14 Topics
